scope: second structural card of the B line: the B.1 adapter delta gated on record presence (correction=v2, identity taiji-u2-subject-v7); retention earned on record-present distractor rounds, record-free check declared structural monitor

lineage.parent_bundles: A.5 pre-feedback bundles, one per seed, byte-identical (same start as B.1)

born.init: same as B.1: first layer from the seeded stream continuation, last layer zero => neutral at birth

lineage.structural_delta_vs_b1: presence gate only (valid.any() multiplier); no new parameters

read_code.rule: zeros(24); code[class] = 1.0; both branches receive the same code at joint_readout
read_code.injection: forward hook on joint_readout replaces its output with joint_readout(code); training, evaluation and feedback use the same path
read_code.limitation: the code carries the read's four-way answer, not the scene's pixels; a pass measures byte expression, not content-conditioned binding

task_b.definition: fact revision: the environment legally releases a record stating the queried entity's new position; the answer target is that new position; the first pass only sees the read and is wrong by construction
task_b.template_rule: the answer word must land at a different byte offset in each template; with a single template every record puts the answer at byte 21, and 'copy bytes 21..27' would pass the gate without reading the fact
task_b.counter_fact_arm: a second arm releases a record whose answer contradicts the truth; a subject that reads the record must answer differently, a fixed-offset copier cannot

measured_headroom.note: the gain is not zero by construction; an update has something to buy

measured_content_sensitivity.note: the channel reacts to the answer word (delta 0.47) but the copy position does not yet point at it (entropy 3.40 over thirty positions), so there is real work for an update to do

measured_protocol_limits.unseen_query: routing is numerically but not operationally query-sensitive: a paraphrase moves route mass by 1e-6, so an unseen-query gate cannot rest on routing; the unseen query is therefore measured by changing the request wording and the template, and by scoring only rounds whose wording was never released
measured_protocol_limits.cross_session: records, released ids and fast memory all survive a save/reload boundary and routing after reload equals routing before (0.527698 / 0.472302)
measured_protocol_limits.multi_fact: with two records released the route is query-blind (0.345389 against 0.345390), so task B is single-fact per episode by design

measured_gate_structure.note: the copy gate is a function of the read code only, so it cannot switch on the presence of a record; the switch has to come from the record route and the copy position, which are the parameters this card trains

criteria.question: does gating the correction delta on record presence let correction and retention hold at once, with retention earned on record-present distractor rounds
criteria.response_round: exact answer bytes plus EOS plus valid UTF-8, greedy, 65-byte cap
criteria.denominator: the 24 first-pass fit errors per seed, same subject, same template assignment
criteria.retention_arm: distractor A: the 32 fit questions re-asked with a legally released record about a DIFFERENT entity; correct answer stays the frozen truth; damage = pre-feedback distractor accuracy - post-feedback distractor accuracy, baseline measured per seed at start (adapter zero at birth => baseline equals v4-with-record)
criteria.retention_is_not_tautological: the presence gate opens on distractor rounds (a record is present), the trained adapter is live there and can damage them; the record-free A check is EXACTLY zero by construction (gate closed) and is declared monitor-only, never citable as earned retention (the A.5 trap)
criteria.distractor_rule: other entity = next fit example's entity (skip one if equal, must differ); label = queried example's revised position, or 左边 for unknown targets; template = index % 4; single record, legally released; distractors are NEVER trained on
criteria.gate_structure: correction=v2 multiplies the adapter delta by valid.any() (the copy branch's presence signal); smoke must prove: perturbation cannot move record-free A (closed exact), perturbation moves record-present B (open), knockout restores v4 even with records, returned context equals base+ungated-adapter with a record and base without
criteria.bootstrap: world-paired per example (learned - control), 2000 resamples, seed 20261116, 95% lower bound > 0
criteria.stability: first-pass correct to second-pass wrong <= max(1, 0.10 * first-pass correct)
criteria.seed_rule: a positive exit requires correction >= gate, distractor damage <= gate and gain >= gate on all three seeds
criteria.protocol: B.1 lean unchanged: one error released at a time, k=8 updates per error, no rollback, no diagnostic re-asks, final full pass for the gate; control exposure 3 episodes
criteria.counterfactual_arm: the counter record (third position, same entity) must be followed at >= 0.8 on every seed that reaches the correction gate
criteria.knockout_arm: with the correction verification cut: B accuracy <= first pass + 0.05 and A digest == baseline digest
criteria.control_arm: zero-update control: 3 legally released exposure episodes, parameters bit-identical, second pass over all 24 == first pass
criteria.path_purity: all 176 non-trainable base tensors bit-identical to the start bundle; the 8 emission tensors (3919 scalars) stay frozen throughout
criteria.recovery: independent process reloads the post-feedback bundle; 32 A + 24 B + 32 distractor rounds byte-identical
criteria.teacher_forcing: forbidden at evaluation; record_loss uses teacher forcing for the loss only (declared, as in A.5/A.6/B.1)
criteria.start_state: A.5 pre-feedback bundle per seed, byte-identical (same start as B.1, NOT B.1 post-feedback); v7 inherits 194 tensors, 4 adapter tensors born zero-neutral
criteria.structural_variable: exactly one over B.1: the presence gate on the adapter delta; trainable set, data, protocol, thresholds otherwise identical

criteria_canonicalization: json.dumps(criteria, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',',':')) utf-8 sha256
